interpretation_limits: Recorded Top actions are Bronze trajectories and cannot adapt to a changed focal policy.
Co-movement may reflect state, lineage, or continuation-package selection rather than an isolated causal effect.
Any Sheep Continuation candidate must be implemented and evaluated later at E3/E4; this analysis cannot promote it.
